batting.name: RM Patidar
batting.dismissal: c SPD Smith b AR Patel

batting.name: GJ Maxwell
batting.dismissal: c SPD Smith b A Mishra

batting.name: PP Shaw
batting.dismissal: c AB de Villiers b HV Patel

batting.name: S Dhawan
batting.dismissal: c YS Chahal b KA Jamieson

batting.name: SPD Smith
batting.dismissal: c AB de Villiers b Mohammed Siraj

batting.name: MP Stoinis
batting.dismissal: c AB de Villiers b HV Patel

balls.text: full outside off, there in the slot for the straight drill over the bowler, but he's gone a little too hard at it and mistimed it. To the bowler's left and he manages to get two hands on it, without fully stopping it
shuffles and whips over cover this time! Another short one, wide outside off. Walks into it and hammers it on the up

shuffles across and whips it over short fine! This is tentative and meek from Stoinis, and who can blame him? This is dropped short, an attempted slower short one. Sits up and is belted with a hook, onto the roof of his team's dugout
left alone but that is pretty safely inside the tramline. It's another overpitched ball and Stoinis is a little lucky that AB has misjudged this
drilled into the boundary padding. Friendly, overpitched ball outside off. Clears the front leg and and has a whippy swing at this
short and wide outside off, cut to sweeper's left
goes full and wide, and overdoes it. Left alone
dipping yorker at middle stump, crunched along the floor to long-on
dropped short outside off and hauled to long-on's right for his fifty. He didn't get all of this pull shot, but there was enough to get it between long-on and deep midwicket
yorker outside off, shuffles and looks to carve that behind point, but it comes off the toe-end
length outside off, shuffles and has a swing on the up. That's onto him quickly and he can only end up slicing to long-off's left
another yorker, at leg stump. Clears the front leg and drags this down to long-on

in-dipping yorker at off and middle. Jams it back to the bowler who has appealed for a catch! The umpires have sent it upstairs. AB is unfazed. He's met that on the full, off the toe-end, and hit it straight into the pitch. That's not out

taken pitch-side. Short ball, cramping him at the chest. He wants to pull that away, he's not in shape, perhaps not even looking it at it by the end. The bat turns in his hands, one of them comes off, and it hangs nicely for Rabada. Sundar's batting form continues to desert him
yorker at middle stump, clears the front leg and jams it down to long-on
pulled neatly over deep midwicket. Short of a length and rising outside off. Right into the arc for the aerial pull and that is sent flying
short and at off stump, backs into the leg side and slices to third man
full at middle stump, clears the front leg and drills to long-on
nails a middle-stump yorker, clears the front leg and jammed through vacant midwicket
short and just outside off, cut into the floor and out to sweeper cover
full and wide outside off, clears the front leg and drives to sweeper's left
short of a length just outside off, pushed straight to point off the back foot
full and at off stump, mistimed straight loft, on the bounce to long-off
short and outside off, looks to pull behind square but is through that early. It dips on Pant a little as he gathers at thigh height
short of a length and down leg side, nudged to fine leg's left where Mishra absorbs the pace on the ball as he goes to floor to stop
short outside off, gets on top of that and steers to short third. Sundar calls early for the run and draws an overthrow at long-on
short of a length at off stump, dropped into the off side with soft hands
short of a length just outside off, steered to backward point off the back foot

sliced past short third! AB enjoys bowlers like Rabada, who prefer to go full at the back end of the innings. This is overpitched and just outside off, he gets leg side of it and opens the face to bisect the two fielders square on the off side
short of a length and just outside off, chopped down to third man
low full toss outside off, driven on the bounce to extra cover
length on leg stump, punched to long-on's left

pulls straight to long-on! He can't believe that. It's short of a length and into him, there for a pretty vicious pull. But it is flat and to Smith's right, and he tracks it nicely to hold on to a sharp one
length at middle stump, whipped to long-on off the back foot
crunched over the bowler! Length ball, just outside off. That's all the room AB needs. Clears the front leg and swings through the line of this straighter one
length and into middle stump, mistimed slog, on the bounce to long-on
length at off stump, driven on the rise to long-off
short of a length outside off, steps out and pulls, gets it to deep midwicket's left off the thick inside edge

hooked over short fine. Short and up at the throat, gets inside the line of that and times this nicely. No need to keep it down because the fielder is in. The surprise short delivery hasn't worked on him this time
thick outside edge as he steps out at this legcutter. Length at off stump, wanted to lift that over mid-off or extra after jumping down. It ends up at sweeper
length and sliding into the corridor, driven on the rise to extra cover
legcutter at a length on off stump, steps down and punches to long-on
length at middle and leg stump, flicked to deep midwicket
short of a length at off stump, punched to long-off off the back foot
short and just outside off, punched off the back foot to long-off's left
length at middle stump, patted to long-on off the back foot
length outside off, steps out and drives to long-off
short of a length and into leg stump, whipped to deep midwicket's left
length and sliding on at leg stump, driven back to the bowler

just short of Smith at backward point. 143kph, short and rising steeply at Patidar who is caught unaware and looks to fend this into the leg side. Closes the face too early and Smith runs in and can't get there
short of a length at leg stump, whipped to deep midwicket
hammered past mid-off. Slower ball dropped short and sitting up nicely outside off. He gets on the front foot and slaps through the line of this
length at off stump, punched on the rise towards extra cover
short of a length at leg stump, dabbed to midwicket off the back foot. A direct hit from there but Patidar has grounded nicely, third umpire confirms
length and into leg stump, leans in and clips this to fine leg's left
googly, turning into middle stump from a length. Punched to long-on off the back foot
tossed up wide outside off, driven along the floor to long-off
short of a length at middle stump, waits and waits before punching to long-on
clean strike over long-on. Tossed right up at off stump, turning away but he's close enough to negate that and launch this with his shape intact
length and dipping outside off, rising along with the turn. Steered to point's left with the turn
googly, turning into off stump and staying low from a length. Hurriedly punched to long-off
short and wide outside off, cut to sweeper cover
length outside off, driven on the rise to long-off
short of a length and skidding low at leg stump, forced to deep midwicket off the back foot
length outside off, steps out and is beaten in flight. Pushes it back to the bowler
length at middle stump, driven to long-on
length at off stump, skidding on at off stump. Driven on the rise to extra cover
full outside off, driven with the turn to long-off
googly not picked and into the pad off the inside edge. AB exposed the stumps to this short of a length ball at middle stump, had to adjust quickly as he got cramped
tossed up outside off, right to the pitch of that to flick through midwicket

dragged straight to long-on! Trademark Mishra wicket this. It is despairingly slow and loopy outside off, turning away. Maxwell's eyes light up and he looks to club this against the turn. It's come off the toe-end and that is now five times he's fallen to Mishra
tossed up outside off, clears the front leg and mistimes the slog to long-on's right
slider at a length outside off, looks to crunch that on the rise, gets it to midwicket off the inside edge
length and into leg stump, deep in the crease and he pushes through midwicket
leading edge and through Axar after a bounce. Short of a length and slow at leg stump, closes the face too early on it
swung over long-on! Full at middle and off, reaches the pitch of that and uses the angle into him - that's a straighter one - to get a nice swing away
length and sliding into the pad at leg stump as he looks to flick
length at middle stump, expertly pushed into the midwicket region with soft hands. Patidar calls nice and early to come back for the second
full and just outside off, driven to extra cover
short of a length and turning away outside off, cut to sweeper
cross-seam legbreak tossed up full outside off, Maxwell gets into his stride and drills that straight over the bowler
length outside off, driven on the rise to long-off
short and wide outside off, cut to sweeper
length and turning away from outside off, very very low. Waits on that and punches to sweeper
tossed up at off stump, driven to long-off
short of a length and just outside off, opens the face and runs it to short third
full slower ball outside off, clears the front leg and looks to drill that past mid-on. Comes off the toe-end
short of a length outside off, punched firmly to cover point
slower ball at a length, just outside off. Pushes in front of the body and gets an inside edge onto pad
cracked through cover. Dropped short outside off, nice skiddy bowling style for the punch, and Maxwell gets on his toes and nails the timing to get this past extra cover
length and tailing into the corridor. Gets forward and closes the face to turn this into midwicket
length outside off, leans in and taps it to cover, and that is a wicket maiden for Ishant
full and at middle stump, driven back at the bowler who gets a hand on it
knuckle ball, short and wide outside off, cut straight to cover
length and into middle stump, pushed out to mid-on
length outside off, driven on the rise to extra cover

cuts through him and hits the top of off! This is a proper Test match stock delivery from Ishant, length and slanted across middle but holding its line, met with a closed face as Devdutt looks to get this into the midwicket region. He's left a bit of a gap between bat and pad and has been beaten by pace

chops it on and off stump is out of the ground! I can hear shouting again, this time from the bowler. Short of a length and jagging into the corridor, width getting tighter and tighter off the surface as Kohli shapes to play the late cut again
length and down leg side, he's walked down at this and reaches for the flick, can't connect
overpitched and just outside off, eager on the drive this time and can only manage a mistimed stab to cover. Shouts in anger again
short and wide outside off, eager on the upper cut but goes early at it and misses. Shouts in anger
slower ball at a length, steps out and times this drive nicely, straight to mid-off
jabbed to the third man boundary. No slip and Kohli uses the freedom to run this fine. Short of a length and into the corridor, opens the face and gets it away
length and just outside off, 142kph, defended on the front foot
full slower ball outside off, flicks it to mid-on and survives! Direct hit from Rabada and Kohli was gone. Dhawan was in a nice position to see this at midwicket and he tells Kohli that as well
length and just outside off, opens the face and drops into the off side with soft hands
slower ball dropped short at middle stump, nicely on top of that to swipe to the long leg boundary

Axar makes a mess of this at mid-on and puts it down. Technically he hasn't put it down because he's ended up in such a bad position that he can't get a finger on it. A knuckle ball outside off at length, walks down and looks to blaze it over mid-on. Axar ends up running circles, going back and to his right. By the end he's had to lunge to his left
big appeal for a catch down leg side. Umpire says no, and they don't review. Length and just outside leg stump, a slower one. Leans in for the flick and it looks like that's come off his thigh
length outside off, gets forward and opens the face to steer this to deep backward point's left
full and just outside off, check-drive straight to mid-off, and Avesh fumbles to allow them a run
oh lovely timing! Length ball swung in from outside off, into the corridor. He leans in, gets very low, and clips this with the angle through vacant midwicket
inside edge as he looks to stab a full toss outside off. Looks like he was surprised by that one. Angled bat down on it, it ends up at fine leg
beaten as he searches for another one coming into him. This overpitched ball goes straight on outside off and beats his attempted drive
shoveled wide of short fine. Good length and swung in sharply from an off stump line. He puts in half a stride and closes the face late on this to find the long leg boundaru
full inswinger thudding into the pads as he looks for the flick, a half-appeal for lbw but that's pitched outside leg
length and just outside off, looks like that comes on a little slow. Looks to defend, bottom hand off, and gets an inside edge to short fine's right
short of a length and across the corridor, beaten on the late cut
carved over point. Gets a lot of width, there's no one back square on the off side and he just runs his hands through this. Length ball going across him and he helps it along
good length and curving away from the corridor, hangs the bat out again and is beaten
shaped past the corridor. Short of a length and swung away. Stabs at it and is beaten
good length and slanted into leg stump, plants the front leg across and flicks to deep square

reaches out and slices it past point but that won't do. It's a low full toss wide outside off and he reaches out a long way, he was setting up inside the crease and there was no way he could have swung at that

slashed between point and short third! An ungainly hoick at this full toss outside off. Wants to pump it over midwicket, but that flies off the face of the bat. It's a high full toss, but the umpire says it's not above waist as he asks
full at leg stump, mistimes the attempted slog, it's along the floor to deep midwicket's right. That's fifty for Pant but all he's doing is shaking his head at missing out on that ball
mistimed and back to the bowler! Oh that was in the slot outside off and he's gone too hard at it. The bat turns in his hands and it's back to the bowler on the bounce
nails the yorker. Hetmyer is slipping and sliding as he looks to clip this off his toes, they can only get one
whipped straight to deep square. Another helicopter whip against a full toss. It's on the leg stump. Stopped on the bounce by Jamieson. Kohli not happy with the delivery

yorker length at off and once again they pick up two off a bowler deflection. He jammed this towards long-off, Harshal stuck a right hand high to try and grab it. Parries it and wants cover to clean that up, but he's too far and they get an extra run
slower ball at a length outside off, hammered on the up to long-off

helicopter to deep midwicket's left off a full toss on off stump. Sams looks to pat that in with his left-hand stretched. Manages to get a hand too, but the momentum takes him over the rope and the ball rolls into the padding before he can recover
yorker at leg stump, dug into the leg side to bring up a 23-ball fifty. Points the handle to the dugout and salutes. He's waited to show up for them, and he has tonight
shuffles and waits outside off, full slower ball drilled out to deep extra cover
yorker at leg stump, flicks it straight to square leg

carted over long-on! Shimron Hetmyer doing the business against his old team! Jamieson misses his length again, right in the slot and angled across the corridor. Once again he's moved into position to be behind this and swung cleanly

yorker outside off, looks to squeeze that past extra cover, cue-ends it to the bowler and says no. But Jamieson can't get down quickly enough to field and the deflection towards midwicket gives them two
shuffles and swings this over deep midwicket too! Jamieson coming apart in his last over. Bowls driving length at middle stump, Hetmyer has shuffled to line that up and swung cleanly across it
gets it past him. Yorker dips under his attempted drive outside off

crack! That's the sound as this leaves Hetmyer's bat. A knee-high full toss outside off and he muscles this slog over deep midwicket. Doing the same thing to Jamieson - making him bowl outside off by shuffling
ends up on the floor as he gets down for the ramp. A full ball outside off, hits the cue-end of the bat and rolls into the leg side
shuffles again and looks to whip it square, but this full toss is tight on his body and he can only pat it to deep midwicket's right

stretches his hands at this and finds the extra cover boundary. It's a knee-high full toss and a free-hit, really, for him. Forcing Harshal to push it wider and wider because he's shuffling and trying to open up that square leg region where both fielders are inside the circle
steps out and meets this yorker on the full, flicks to deep midwicket's left
yorker at off stump, dug out in front of the stumps
full and just outside off, steps out and drives it straight to extra cover
dipping yorker, away from off stump. Shuffles and drives it out to long-on
he finishes well indeed. Yorker outside off, can only be forced out to long-off from deep in the crease
low full toss outside off, driven along the ground to long-off
oh misses out. Hetmyer will feel horrible at the other end. It's a full toss on the pad, with backward square and short fine in the circle. He flicks it straight to the former
yorker just outside off, jabbed at extra cover off the front foot
full and just outside off, driven straight to extra cover

Padikkal runs in from long-on and drops after making his ground. Looks like he lost shape at the last moment. It's a high full toss outside off, he looks to slap that over midwicket and has ended up too far from it. Slices it up and Padikkal has over-run and had to reach out behind his shoulder
low full toss at off stump, flicked to deep midwicket
full and just outside off, jammed down to long-off
yorker at the front toe, 143kph, squeezed out to deep midwicket's left
pumped between deep midwicket and deep square. A slower short ball sitting up at middle stump, springs into that on the front foot and pulls hard
just clears long-on. Length ball pushed across him from middle stump, but he clears the front leg and meets this on the rise. Has a slog at it, not off the middle, but enough for six
length and across off stump, clears the front leg and slashes inelegantly out to sweeper
length at middle stump, whipped to deep midwicket off the back foot
length at off stump, turning away as he jumps down at this. Can only stab towards point
full on off stump, driven with the turn to long-off
length at middle stump, flicked through midwicket
length at middle stump, nudged to deep square off the back foot
short of a length outside off, punched to extra cover off the back foot
looks to hook and that ends up at third man. A slower short ball, looks for the pull and is early into it. Looks like he's got glove on it in the end
full slower ball outside off, driven on the rise to extra cover

screeches in delight after drawing the edge! Good length and wide outside off, Stoinis chucks his hands at that and gets it off the outside edge. A straightforward catch for AB and Harshal is not hiding his joy
full outside off, sliced out to sweeper cover
slower ball at a length on leg stump, looks to play the lap sweep and has got a bit of thigh on that. The umpire calls wide and AB shows the review signal
full and down leg side, beaten on the attempted flick
short of a length outside off, slashed on the rise and quickly past point. Sweeper has no chance to his right

swiped over deep square jumping to his left. He's a few yards in, he has to go to his left after Pant picks this up off his thigh. Harshal slants it into him from around the wicket. Clears the fielder
get out of the way again, Rishabh! Another short of a length ball at off stump, once again he's deep in the crease to pump this past Pant who is on the floor at the other end
length at middle stump, steps out and stabs towards long-on
length, at the stumps, and pushed through the leg side
short and just outside off, backs away and hammers this past his panicky partner at the other end
short of a length in the corridor, gets deep in the crease and jabs through midwicket
short and across off stump, muscled to sweeper cover off the back foot
googly at a length, plants the front foot out and blocks into the leg side
short at off stump, can't get his punch past midwicket
short and wide outside off, cut to sweeper point
full and just outside off, swept straight to square leg
short and wide outside off, cut to sweeper point
slider at a length, middle and leg. Gets low and laps this fine. Nicely in control of that
short of a length and wide outside off, cut to sweeper's left
length at the stumps, steps out and flicks to long-on
length at leg stump, steps out and pushes with soft hands through midwicket
just clears extra cover. Length outside off, steps out and has a hack at this because he's not to the pitch. It's a one-handed loft into the air and well clear of Kohli running back
length and into leg stump, steps out and flicks to deep midwicket
short of a length and sliding on outside off, pulled firmly down to long-on
very short, but skidding on low outside off. Reaches out for the cut but can only stab that to extra cover
length at off stump, hangs deep and punches to long-off

now they've appealed for lbw. Stoinis is down the pitch and seems to have missed what looks like a slider. He's struck in front of middle and off, trying to drive that. Was beaten in flight and instinctively plonked his foot in front of the bat. Umpire doesn't say anything about shot not offered. That's hitting leg stump but because he's 3 metres down the pitch, he survives. It becomes umpire's call
short and wide outside off, slaughtered with an angled bat, to extra cover but hit so hard that he can only parry it towards long-on
length at middle stump, punched to long-on

is that a dropped catch from AB? It's a googly first up, he's beaten on the cut bcause he has no idea how that is turning. Not sure what it's hit, or whether it's hit anything at all. There was a sound, but that may have been the top of the back pad. There's no lbw appeal, which is why I suspected there was a nick on it. But no, Ultra Edge confirms that was the pad flap, of the back leg. Not a drop. But no appeal. Would have been umpire's call
full and wide outside off, driven firmly to backward point
full slower ball at off stump, punched down to long-on off the front foot
length and headed for the top of off, leans in and punches to long-on
length outside off, reaches out and slashes aerially to third man's right

short and wide outside off, he chases it and there's a faint sound on that! And Shaw walks off. That was wide - literally, past the tramline. He wants to slash that behind point and has got a thin outside edge
length and into leg stump, jabbed out to deep square with the angle
length at middle stump, steps out and pushes to deep midwicket's right
short and wide outside off, sticking in the surface and flying to long-off off the toe-end as he looks to cut
length at the stumps, punched back to the bowler
short of a length and tight at middle stump, backs away and punches to extra cover
length and into middle stump, steps out and punches to long-on

a sustained plea from Sundar and it's been given lbw. He is bowling around the wicket, Pant has looked to sweep him and has been struck in front of leg stump. He reviews. Counting on the angle taking that down? Oh no, there is an inside edge on it. So he's survive. Was through that sweep a little early
slower bouncer at middle stump, hauled out to deep square
slower short ball at off stump, pulled firmly to deep square's right. Paddikal slides to stop
full at leg stump, looks to flick and that's deflected to short fine off the front pad. Has to hurry back in as Shaw sends him back

slog sweep! That's gonna hurt the ego. It's a slower ball at a length outside off, he's found time to be down on one knee - he's already batting a yard outside the crease - and swipe this over midwicket
length outside off, driven on the rise to mid-off

chipped to deep square's left and short of him. Slower ball at a length on middle stump, into that early for the lofted flick, can't control it. Patidar throws it back and Shaw is labouring in at the non-striker's end as Sams can't gather cleanly
cutter at a length on off stump, they can't pick a boundary off this one. Pushed with soft hands into the off side
length and just outside off, defended on the front foot
short of a length at leg stump, uses the angle to stab that to fine leg
good length and angled in at middle stump, pushes for the original line, gets that forward block off the inside half of the bat
length and into leg stump, looks for the flick and cops that on the pad
length outside off, blocked on the front foot
oh can't finish a good over off. Full toss just outside off, a check-drive blazed past extra cover
short of a length and tight at off stump, thinks about the pull but offers the straight bat and defends
length and just outside off, stabbed to mid-off's right off the front foot. Slight hesitation on the run but safely through

straightens that and draws the edge! Lovely delivery. Length and angled into the corridor, but straightening off the pitch. A cross seam delivery. Smith looks to drive on the rise and gets a big edge through to AB
length and just outside off, looks to drive on the rise, can't beat a tumbling Kohli to the right at extra cover
short of a length on leg stump, whipped to deep square
dropped short outside off, comes on nicely for him and he pulls firmly over midwicket
length and cutting into off stump, defended into the covers
short of a length and just outside off, punched on the up towards mid-off

he's steered it straight to fine leg! That's a little tame, but it's a plan that's worked for Jamieson. Clear plan to cramp Dhawan this over. This time he follows him down leg side, gets it up at the hips. He wants to use the pace and get that over the fielder but he picks him out
length and in at off stump, steps out and is cramped. Forced to defend
short of a length outside off, chopped to point from the crease
length outside off, punched on the up to sweeper's right
full slower ball outside off, floating nicely into the slot and he drills it past the bowler's legs

that's sprinted past AB and RCB are thinking about the lbw review. They won't take it. This is short of a length and down leg side, hits him well outside the line as he shapes to pull. That stayed low and took the outside of his front leg
length at leg stump, clipped through square leg
length and into off stump, dropped in front of point with soft hands
full and into the pads, stands tall and whips that wide of mid-on. Searching for swing that isn't there
offcutter, short and turning into middle stump. Dhawan gets on the front foot and pulls past midwicket
beaten on the upper cut. Short ball really sticks in the pitch and pings up like a rubber ball outside off. He can't get that away
slower ball at a length on leg stump, whipped to fine leg
short of a length and some shape away in the corridor, chopped into the vacant cover region
full outside off, flowing drive on the up to sweeper cover
length and just outside off, driven on the rise to extra cover
